clues: This town sits on a big river in the flat grass lands of its state. Farms and fields spread out on all sides.
Bad storms hit this town a lot, with big hail, wild winds, and twisters. Snow is rare and soon melts.
Long ago, a trade post stood on a bluff by the river. The state picked that bluff as the site for its new capital town.
Deep down under this town sleeps a dead volcano. Its peak lies far below the streets, right under a sports hall.
The governor of Mississippi works in this city, the largest in the state. Lawmakers meet here to make the state's laws.
